items.title: Turkey reports a record 394 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 40,131.
The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights claims that twenty air strikes have hit the northern areas of Aleppo. Bombardments by both sides have killed nearly 250 people since April 22.
An overloaded ferry capsizes on the Brahmaputra River in India killing at least 103 people.
The recent US tornado outbreak becomes the second deadliest single day tornado event in US history with at least 340 people dead.
